lines.t: You are with me even now
I'm your forgiven child, no records left to keep
Carrying no memory of the things I rehearsed in my sleep
So I begin again in you
I lift my eyes, I turn my view
I won't keep counting for you, don't
Even what is yet to come
So I will stop rehearsing sin
And fix my eyes on grace
So I begin again in you
I lift my eyes, I turn my view
I won't keep count of what you do
We walk it side by side
As far away as east from west, this where my past now stays
Won't provide what you lay down, I let it pass away
If the sun has set me free, then I am free indeed
I won't carry what you buried, I won't buy into what you released
I come to you with all my weight
Taking your yoke, I learn your pace
And you, my soul, finds quiet ground
So I begin again in you
I trust the work you say is through
